# 5. Examine spatial trends and multiple testing

## 5.1 Check caches or calculate missing fields

This stage concerns five variables × five periods × 172,800 grid points at the
expected native resolution. No gridpoint bootstrap is introduced. It retains
the local Zhang test/slope estimator and equal-month aggregation.

An old `.RData` is loaded into a private environment so its saved configuration
cannot overwrite the current settings. Reuse requires matching grid dimensions,
coordinates, years, variable coverage, old-versus-corrected month assignments,
and recalculated slopes/p-values/tau at 24 distributed points per field.
**This sample check is not proof that every cached cell is correct.** The
output retains a `provenance` column identifying adopted legacy results.

If these checks fail, inspect `Legacy_Spatial_Cache_Check.csv` when available.
There is no automatic fallback to accepting a mismatch. Set
`ALLOW_SPATIAL_RECOMPUTE=TRUE` only when ready to calculate missing fields from
the existing monthly NetCDF. Every completed field is checkpointed. Set
`FORCE_SPATIAL_RECOMPUTE=TRUE` as well only to deliberately replace an existing
corrected spatial calculation. Neither flag runs the Python preprocessing.

```{r spatial-cache-and-computation}
#| eval: !expr RUN_SPATIAL
# Spatial computation is independent of the bootstrap on domain means.
# Its input is the monthly NetCDF; its output is one matrix per variable/period.
# Legacy caches are loaded into a private environment, never into global settings.
spatial_signature <- object_hash(list(schema = "spatial-zhang-v1",
  input = reference$identity, dates = reference$dates,
  lat = lat_arctic, lon = lon, years = years_vec,
  variables = SPATIAL_VARS, zyp = as.character(packageVersion("zyp")),
  aggregation = "equal months; complete finite years; preserve.range FALSE"))
SPATIAL_CACHE <- file.path(OUTPUT_DATA_DIR, "Spatial_Trends_Corrected.rds")
LEGACY_SPATIAL_CACHE <- file.path(LEGACY_DATA_DIR, "Phase3_4_Spatial_Results.RData")
spatial_results <- list()
spatial_provenance <- "new computation"
lat_arc <- lat_arctic; lon_vec <- lon
n_lat <- length(lat_arc); n_lon <- length(lon_vec)

# Reject incomplete or structurally invalid cache objects before plotting them.
check_spatial_structure <- function(result) {
  if (!all(SPATIAL_VARS %in% names(result))) return(FALSE)
  for (v in SPATIAL_VARS) {
    r <- result[[v]]
    if (is.null(r$annual) || !all(SEASONS %in% names(r$seasonal))) return(FALSE)
    fields <- c(list(Annual = r$annual), r$seasonal[SEASONS])
    for (p in names(fields)) {
      f <- fields[[p]]
      yy <- if (p == "Annual") f$years else f$season_years
      if (!identical(as.integer(yy), as.integer(years_vec))) return(FALSE)
      for (key in c("slope", "p_local", "tau")) {
        if (!identical(dim(f[[key]]), c(n_lat, n_lon))) return(FALSE)
      }
      valid <- is.finite(f$p_local)
      if (!any(valid) || any(f$p_local[valid] < 0 | f$p_local[valid] > 1) ||
          any(!is.finite(f$slope[valid]))) return(FALSE)
    }
  }
  TRUE
}

read_point <- function(nc, variable, latitude_index, longitude_index) {
  actual <- resolve_variable(nc, variable)
  dn <- vapply(nc$var[[actual]]$dim, function(d) d$name, character(1))
  assert_that(setequal(dn, c("time","latitude","longitude")), "Unexpected dimensions.")
  start <- setNames(rep(1L, 3), dn); count <- start
  start["latitude"] <- latitude_index; start["longitude"] <- longitude_index
  count["time"] <- -1L
  as.numeric(ncdf4::ncvar_get(nc, actual, start = start, count = count))
}

validate_legacy_cache <- function(result, cached_lat, cached_lon) {
  if (!isTRUE(all.equal(cached_lat, lat_arc)) ||
      !isTRUE(all.equal(cached_lon, lon_vec)) || !check_spatial_structure(result))
    return(list(ok = FALSE, reason = "Legacy grid, years, variables or matrices do not match."))
  # Reproduce the OLD spatial date conversion, then compare month membership.
  # This tests whether the date-parser correction actually changes those groups.
  old_dates <- tryCatch({
    assert_that(grepl("^days since ", reference$time_units), "Old code assumed days.")
    as.Date(sub("days since ", "", reference$time_units)) + reference$raw_time
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(old_dates) ||
      !identical(format(old_dates, "%Y-%m"), format(reference$dates, "%Y-%m")))
    return(list(ok = FALSE, reason = "Old and corrected month assignments differ or cannot be compared."))

  nc <- ncdf4::nc_open(METRICS_FILE)
  on.exit(ncdf4::nc_close(nc), add = TRUE)
  # Fixed, distributed points make the check reproducible without a grid rerun.
  points <- expand.grid(lat = unique(round(seq(1,n_lat,length.out=4))),
                        lon = unique(round(seq(1,n_lon,length.out=6))))
  audit <- list()
  full_lat <- match(lat_arc, reference$lat)
  for (v in SPATIAL_VARS) for (i in seq_len(nrow(points))) {
    li <- points$lat[i]; lj <- points$lon[i]
    monthly <- read_point(nc, v, full_lat[li], lj)
    for (p in c("Annual", SEASONS)) {
      y <- aggregate_series(monthly, index, p)
      fit <- zhang_fit(y, years_vec)
      f <- if (p == "Annual") result[[v]]$annual else result[[v]]$seasonal[[p]]
      expected <- c(unname(fit["trend"])*DECADES, unname(fit["sig"]), unname(fit["tau"]))
      cached <- c(f$slope[li,lj], f$p_local[li,lj], f$tau[li,lj])
      pass <- all(is.finite(cached)) && all(abs(expected-cached) <= 1e-7 + 1e-6*abs(expected))
      audit[[length(audit)+1L]] <- tibble(variable=v, period=p,
        latitude=lat_arc[li], longitude=lon_vec[lj],
        slope_cached=cached[1], slope_checked=expected[1],
        p_cached=cached[2], p_checked=expected[2], passed=pass)
    }
  }
  table <- bind_rows(audit)
  write_csv(table, file.path(OUTPUT_DATA_DIR,"Legacy_Spatial_Cache_Check.csv"))
  list(ok = all(table$passed), reason = if (all(table$passed))
    "Month/grid checks and sampled recalculations passed; original provenance remains unverified."
    else "Sampled recalculations differ from cached values.")
}

# Reuse a corrected cache only when its recorded input identity and settings match.
if (file.exists(SPATIAL_CACHE) && !FORCE_SPATIAL_RECOMPUTE) {
  candidate <- readRDS(SPATIAL_CACHE)
  if (identical(candidate$signature, spatial_signature)) {
    spatial_results <- candidate$results
    spatial_provenance <- candidate$provenance
    cat("Loaded corrected spatial cache; completed fields will be reused.\n")
  } else cat("Corrected cache is incompatible with current inputs/settings.\n")
}
if (length(spatial_results) == 0L && file.exists(LEGACY_SPATIAL_CACHE) &&
    !FORCE_SPATIAL_RECOMPUTE && CHECK_LEGACY_SPATIAL_CACHE) {
  e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  load(LEGACY_SPATIAL_CACHE, envir = e)
  required <- c("spatial_results","lat_arc","lon_vec")
  if (all(vapply(required, exists, logical(1), envir=e, inherits=FALSE))) {
    validation <- validate_legacy_cache(e$spatial_results, e$lat_arc, e$lon_vec)
    cat(validation$reason, "\n")
    if (validation$ok) {
      spatial_results <- e$spatial_results[SPATIAL_VARS]
      spatial_provenance <- "legacy cache; month/grid and 24-point-per-field checks passed; provenance unverified"
      write_rds(list(signature=spatial_signature, results=spatial_results,
                     provenance=spatial_provenance), SPATIAL_CACHE)
    }
  }
}

# No automatic launch of a full grid calculation when a cache fails a check.
needs_compute <- !check_spatial_structure(spatial_results)
if (needs_compute && !ALLOW_SPATIAL_RECOMPUTE) {
  stop(paste("Spatial results are absent, incomplete or incompatible.",
    "Domain-average outputs are already saved. Inspect the cache audit above.",
    "To calculate missing fields from the EXISTING monthly NetCDF, set",
    "ALLOW_SPATIAL_RECOMPUTE <- TRUE in setup-environment and run again.",
    "This does not run reynolds_decomposition.qmd."), call. = FALSE)
}

# Read ONE variable at a time; aggregate to 68 annual/seasonal values.
# Completed fields are checkpointed, so a stopped run resumes at the next field.
if (needs_compute) {
  nc <- ncdf4::nc_open(METRICS_FILE)
  tryCatch({
    ai <- which(reference$lat >= ARCTIC_LAT_THRESHOLD & reference$lat < 90)
    for (v in SPATIAL_VARS) {
      if (is.null(spatial_results[[v]])) spatial_results[[v]] <- list(annual=NULL, seasonal=list())
      cat("Spatial input:", v, "\n")
      data <- read_cube(nc, v)[, ai, , drop=FALSE]
      assert_that(all(is.finite(data)), paste("Missing spatial input values in",v))
      for (p in c("Annual", SEASONS)) {
        existing <- if (p=="Annual") spatial_results[[v]]$annual else spatial_results[[v]]$seasonal[[p]]
        if (!is.null(existing)) next
        cat("Computing spatial trends:", v, p, "\n"); flush.console()
        ids <- period_indices(index,p)
        agg <- array(NA_real_, c(length(ids),n_lat,n_lon))
        for (j in seq_along(ids))
          agg[j,,] <- apply(data[ids[[j]],,,drop=FALSE], c(2,3), mean)
        mat <- matrix(agg, nrow=length(years_vec))
        # A small worker count avoids copying the whole array to many processes.
        batches <- split(seq_len(ncol(mat)), ceiling(seq_len(ncol(mat))/SPATIAL_BATCH_POINTS))
        calculate_batch <- function(cols) {
          vapply(cols, function(i) {
            fit <- zhang_fit(mat[,i],years_vec)
            c(slope=unname(fit["trend"])*DECADES,
              p_local=unname(fit["sig"]), tau=unname(fit["tau"]))
          }, numeric(3))
        }
        if (SPATIAL_WORKERS > 1L) {
          future::plan(future::multisession, workers=SPATIAL_WORKERS)
          ans <- tryCatch(furrr::future_map(batches, calculate_batch,
                     .options=furrr::furrr_options(seed=TRUE), .progress=TRUE),
                     finally=future::plan(future::sequential))
        } else ans <- lapply(batches, calculate_batch)
        ans <- do.call(cbind,ans)
        field <- list(slope=matrix(ans[1,],n_lat,n_lon),
                      p_local=matrix(ans[2,],n_lat,n_lon),
                      tau=matrix(ans[3,],n_lat,n_lon))
        if (p=="Annual") {
          field$years <- years_vec; spatial_results[[v]]$annual <- field
        } else {
          field$season_years <- years_vec; spatial_results[[v]]$seasonal[[p]] <- field
        }
        spatial_provenance <- "computed from checked monthly NetCDF by corrected framework"
        write_rds(list(signature=spatial_signature,results=spatial_results,
                       provenance=spatial_provenance),SPATIAL_CACHE)
        rm(agg,mat,ans); gc(verbose=FALSE)
      }
      rm(data); gc(verbose=FALSE)
    }
  }, finally=ncdf4::nc_close(nc))
}
assert_that(check_spatial_structure(spatial_results), "Spatial output validation failed.")
```

## 5.2 Compute BH discoveries and descriptive local fractions

BH is applied separately to the valid gridpoint tests in each variable–period
family at q = 0.10. For ordered p-values it finds the largest rank k satisfying
p(k) ≤ qk/K and rejects all tests up to that rank. The q/K threshold alone is
not the full procedure. Wilks (2016) motivates q = 2α_global for approximately
calibrated global tests in his correlated-field experiments; q = 0.10 is not a
universal guarantee of FDR ≤ 0.05 for this dataset.

The previous preliminary zero-discovery statement for MAM mean EKE is not
hard-coded. The printed result and CSV below are computed from the current
p-values and are what should be compared with that earlier statement.
The rejection ratio R = fraction(p < 0.05) / 0.05 is descriptive. It has no
calibrated global p-value here. Fractions refer to grid points, not Arctic area.

```{r spatial-bh-and-summary}
#| eval: !expr RUN_SPATIAL
# Always recompute masks and BH from p-values, including when using a cache.
# This avoids trusting obsolete sig_local or precomputed summary columns.
rows <- list()
for (v in SPATIAL_VARS) for (p in c("Annual", SEASONS)) {
  f <- if (p=="Annual") spatial_results[[v]]$annual else spatial_results[[v]]$seasonal[[p]]
  bh <- bh_field(f$p_local)
  f$p_bh <- bh$p_bh
  f$sig_bh <- bh$sig_bh
  f$sig_local <- f$p_local < ALPHA_LOCAL
  n <- bh$n_tests
  local_count <- sum(f$sig_local, na.rm=TRUE)
  minimum <- min(f$p_local[is.finite(f$p_local)])
  # A useful invariant: p_min <= q/K necessarily gives at least one rejection.
  assert_that(!(minimum <= FDR_Q/n && bh$n_discoveries == 0L),
              paste("BH rank-one consistency check failed:",v,p))
  rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- tibble(variable=v,period=p,n_total=n,
    n_missing=length(f$p_local)-n, n_local_sig=local_count,
    pct_local=100*local_count/n, ratio_to_null=local_count/(ALPHA_LOCAL*n),
    min_p=minimum, q=FDR_Q, rank1_threshold=FDR_Q/n,
    n_bh_discoveries=bh$n_discoveries, pct_bh=100*bh$n_discoveries/n,
    zero_p_count=sum(f$p_local==0,na.rm=TRUE), provenance=spatial_provenance)
  if (p=="Annual") spatial_results[[v]]$annual <- f
  else spatial_results[[v]]$seasonal[[p]] <- f
}
field_sig_summary <- bind_rows(rows) # legacy object name retained for compatibility
write_csv(field_sig_summary,file.path(OUTPUT_DATA_DIR,"Spatial_Local_and_BH_Summary.csv"))
write_rds(list(signature=spatial_signature, results=spatial_results,
               provenance=spatial_provenance),SPATIAL_CACHE)
cat("Local fractions and ratios are descriptive; BH counts are reported separately.\n")
display_summary <- field_sig_summary %>% select(-provenance) %>%
  mutate(min_p = format(min_p, scientific=TRUE, digits=4, trim=TRUE),
         rank1_threshold = format(rank1_threshold, scientific=TRUE, digits=4, trim=TRUE))
print(knitr::kable(display_summary,digits=4))
# A printed p=0 is a numerical value from the local test; it is not certainty.
if (any(field_sig_summary$zero_p_count > 0))
  cat("Some local tests returned numerical zero p-values; see zero_p_count in the CSV.\n")
# Export a simple result statement based on the actual current calculation.
mam <- field_sig_summary %>% filter(variable=="eke_synoptic_mean",period=="MAM")
cat(sprintf("Current MAM mean-EKE BH result: %d discoveries among %d tests at q=%.2f.\n",
            mam$n_bh_discoveries,mam$n_total,FDR_Q))
```

## 5.3 Spatial trend maps

The original figure filenames are retained under `Figures_corrected`. Blue
contours show **unadjusted** local p < 0.05; the corrected BH counts and masks
are saved separately. Geographical coherence alone does not establish
significance. Each variable has a shared seasonal colour scale, with annual
maps scaled separately. Bounds round outward to cover all finite slopes.

```{r spatial-trend-maps}
#| eval: !expr RUN_SPATIAL && MAKE_FIGURES
progress_msg <- function(msg) {cat(msg,"\n"); flush.console()}
# ── B1: Cartographic setup ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
progress_msg("B1: Setting up cartographic elements...")

arctic_crs  <- "+proj=laea +lat_0=90 +lon_0=0"
view_radius <- 3330000   # clips at ~60 N data boundary
plot_radius <- 3600000   # space for labels

wrap_data <- function(mat) {
  a <- mat[, order(lon_vec %% 360), drop=FALSE]
  cbind(a, a[,1])
}
lon_base <- sort(lon_vec %% 360)
lon_wrapped <- c(lon_base, lon_base[1]+360)

world       <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
world_polar <- st_transform(world, crs = arctic_crs)

graticules <- st_graticule(
  lon = seq(-180, 180, by = 60),
  lat = c(60, 70, 80),
  crs = 4326
) %>% st_transform(crs = arctic_crs)

lat_labels <- data.frame(lon = 180, lat = c(60, 70, 80)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = arctic_crs)
lat_labels$label <- c("60\u00b0N", "70\u00b0N", "80\u00b0N")

lon_labels <- data.frame(lon = seq(0, 300, by = 60), lat = 58) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = arctic_crs)
lon_labels$label <- c("0\u00b0", "60\u00b0E", "120\u00b0E",
                       "180\u00b0", "120\u00b0W", "60\u00b0W")

circle_mask <- st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 0)), crs = arctic_crs) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = view_radius)

square_box <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -plot_radius, xmax = plot_radius,
    ymin = -plot_radius, ymax = plot_radius),
  crs = arctic_crs
))
inverse_mask <- st_difference(square_box, circle_mask)

progress_msg("  Cartographic elements ready.")


# ── B2: Plotting helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_stars_polar <- function(mat, varname = "value") {
  mat_wrap <- wrap_data(mat)
  mat_wrap <- t(mat_wrap)   # [lat, lon] -> [lon, lat] for stars x/y convention
  dims <- st_dimensions(x = lon_wrapped, y = lat_arc)
  st_as_stars(setNames(list(mat_wrap), varname), dimensions = dims) %>%
    st_set_crs(4326) %>%
    st_warp(crs = arctic_crs) %>%
    { .[circle_mask] }
}

# Return 7 symmetric breaks (including 0) whose step is the next outward multiple
# of 5e-max_dec to (lim / 3).  This guarantees every tick ends in 0 or 5 and
# has at most max_dec decimal places.  oob = squish on the scale handles the
# rare case where the rounded step pushes the outermost break past slope_lim_var.
pretty_breaks_sym <- function(lim, n = 7L, max_dec = 3L) {
  half_n   <- (n - 1L) / 2L                      # = 3 for n = 7
  raw_step <- lim / half_n
  unit     <- 5 * 10^(-max_dec)                  # smallest "nice" step
  nice_step <- ceiling(raw_step / unit) * unit
  if (nice_step <= 0) nice_step <- unit           # safeguard against underflow
  seq(-half_n * nice_step, half_n * nice_step, by = nice_step)
}

make_panel <- function(stars_obj, fill_var, fill_scale, panel_title,
                       sig_contour = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_stars(data = stars_obj, aes(fill = .data[[fill_var]]),
               na.rm = TRUE) +
    fill_scale +
    geom_sf(data = world_polar, fill = NA, color = "black",
            linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = graticules, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_sf(data = inverse_mask, fill = "white", color = NA) +
    geom_sf_text(data = lat_labels, aes(label = label),
                 size = 4, color = "black", hjust = 1.2) +     # 4 mm ≈ 11.3 pt
    geom_sf_text(data = lon_labels, aes(label = label),
                 size = 4, color = "black")                     # 4 mm ≈ 11.3 pt

  # Significance overlay: convert raster to sf polygons to avoid scale conflicts with the slope fill layer
  if (!is.null(sig_contour) && any(sig_contour[[1]] >= 0.5, na.rm=TRUE)) {
    sig_contour[[1]] <- ifelse(
      !is.na(sig_contour[[1]]) & sig_contour[[1]] >= 0.5, 1L, NA_integer_
    )
    sig_sf <- st_as_sf(sig_contour, na.rm = TRUE, merge = TRUE)
    if (nrow(sig_sf) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_sf(data = sig_sf, fill = NA, alpha = 0.2, color = "blue4")
    }
  }

  p +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-plot_radius, plot_radius),
             ylim = c(-plot_radius, plot_radius),
             expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = panel_title) +
    theme_void(base_size = BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = TITLE_SIZE),
      legend.position   = "right",
      legend.title      = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2),
      legend.key.width  = unit(0.6, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(2.0, "cm"),
      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
    )
}


# ── B3: Figure configuration per variable ──────────────────────────────────
var_plot_config <- list(
  eke_synoptic_mean = list(
    fig_annual   = "Fig3.5a_Annual_Trend_Map_EKE_synoptic.png",
    fig_seasonal = "Fig3.5b_Seasonal_Trend_Maps_EKE_synoptic.png",
    unit_expr    = expression(hat(beta) ~ "[" * m^2 * s^{-2} * decade^{-1} * "]"),
    max_dec      = 3L
  ),
  eke_p90 = list(
    fig_annual   = "Fig3.6a_Annual_Trend_Map_P90.png",
    fig_seasonal = "Fig3.6b_Seasonal_Trend_Maps_P90.png",
    unit_expr    = expression(hat(beta) ~ "[" * m^2 * s^{-2} * decade^{-1} * "]"),
    max_dec      = 3L
  ),
  eke_p95 = list(
    fig_annual   = "Fig3.7a_Annual_Trend_Map_P95.png",
    fig_seasonal = "Fig3.7b_Seasonal_Trend_Maps_P95.png",
    unit_expr    = expression(hat(beta) ~ "[" * m^2 * s^{-2} * decade^{-1} * "]"),
    max_dec      = 3L
  ),
  eke_p99 = list(
    fig_annual   = "Fig3.8a_Annual_Trend_Map_P99.png",
    fig_seasonal = "Fig3.8b_Seasonal_Trend_Maps_P99.png",
    unit_expr    = expression(hat(beta) ~ "[" * m^2 * s^{-2} * decade^{-1} * "]"),
    max_dec      = 3L
  ),
  exceed_p95_freq = list(
    fig_annual   = "Fig3.9a_Annual_Trend_Map_ExceedFreq.png",
    fig_seasonal = "Fig3.9b_Seasonal_Trend_Maps_ExceedFreq.png",
    unit_expr    = expression(hat(beta) ~ "[decade" ^{-1} * "]"),
    max_dec      = 4L   # smaller magnitudes need one extra decimal place
  )
)


# ── B4: Generate figures ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (vname in names(spatial_results)) {

  cfg <- var_plot_config[[vname]]
  if (is.null(cfg)) {
    progress_msg(sprintf("  WARNING: No plot config for %s — skipping.", vname))
    next
  }

  res <- spatial_results[[vname]]

  cat("\n", rep("-", 50), "\n")
  progress_msg(sprintf("  Plotting: %s", vname))

  # ── Annual map ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Independent scale: annual slopes (12-month averages) have inherently
  # smaller variance than seasonal slopes (3-month averages), so a shared
  # scale would wash out the annual map.
  slope_ann     <- res$annual$slope
  sig_ann       <- res$annual$sig_local   # <-- local p < 0.05 (NOT FDR)
  slope_lim_ann <- max(abs(slope_ann), na.rm = TRUE)
  breaks_ann    <- pretty_breaks_sym(slope_lim_ann, n = 7L, max_dec = cfg$max_dec)

  # Rejection fraction for subtitle
  n_sig_ann  <- sum(sig_ann, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_tot_ann  <- sum(!is.na(res$annual$p_local))
  pct_ann    <- round(100 * n_sig_ann / n_tot_ann, 1)

  slope_stars <- make_stars_polar(slope_ann, "slope")
  sig_stars   <- make_stars_polar(
    matrix(as.integer(sig_ann), n_lat, n_lon), "sig_mask"
  )

  fill_scale <- scale_fill_distiller(
    name      = cfg$unit_expr,
    palette   = "RdBu",
    direction = -1,
    limits    = range(breaks_ann),
    breaks    = breaks_ann,
    labels    = scales::label_number(accuracy = 5 * 10^(-cfg$max_dec)),
    na.value  = "transparent",
    oob       = scales::squish
  )

  p_ann <- make_panel(
    stars_obj   = slope_stars,
    fill_var    = "slope",
    fill_scale  = fill_scale,
    panel_title = parse(text = paste0(
      'bold("Annual Zhang slope"~', VAR_LABELS_SHORT[[vname]],
      '~"(1958\u20132025)")'
    ))[[1]],
    sig_contour = sig_stars
  ) +
    labs(subtitle = glue(
      "PWMK | Blue contours: unadjusted p < {ALPHA_LOCAL} ",
      "({pct_ann}% of grid points)"
    )) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = SUBTITLE_SIZE, colour = "grey40",
                                       hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      legend.direction  = "horizontal",
      legend.title.position = "top",
      legend.title      = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.width  = unit(3.0, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      plot.margin       = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5))

  ggsave(file.path(FIG_PHASE3, cfg$fig_annual),
         p_ann, width = 10, height = 11, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  progress_msg(sprintf("    Saved: %s", cfg$fig_annual))

  rm(slope_stars, sig_stars, p_ann)

  # ── Seasonal maps (2x2) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Shared scale across all four seasons: true max of absolute slopes
  # across every season, so panels are directly comparable in magnitude.
  slope_lim_seas <- max(
    sapply(res$seasonal, function(x) max(abs(x$slope), na.rm = TRUE))
  )
  breaks_seas <- pretty_breaks_sym(slope_lim_seas, n = 7L, max_dec = cfg$max_dec)

  season_panels <- list()

  for (seas in SEASONS) {
    sr    <- res$seasonal[[seas]]
    sl_st <- make_stars_polar(sr$slope, "slope")
    sg_st <- make_stars_polar(
      matrix(as.integer(sr$sig_local), n_lat, n_lon), "sig_mask"  # <-- local p
    )

    fill_s <- scale_fill_distiller(
      name      = cfg$unit_expr,
      palette   = "RdBu",
      direction = -1,
      limits    = range(breaks_seas),
      breaks    = breaks_seas,
      labels    = scales::label_number(accuracy = 5 * 10^(-cfg$max_dec)),
      na.value  = "transparent",
      oob       = scales::squish
    )

    # Rejection fraction for this season
    n_sig_s <- sum(sr$sig_local, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_tot_s <- sum(!is.na(sr$p_local))
    pct_s   <- round(100 * n_sig_s / n_tot_s, 1)

    season_panels[[seas]] <- make_panel(
      stars_obj   = sl_st,
      fill_var    = "slope",
      fill_scale  = fill_s,
      panel_title = paste0(unname(SEASON_NAMES[seas]), " (", pct_s, "%)"),
      sig_contour = sg_st
    )
  }

  # Style the legend as a horizontal bottom bar on each panel;
  # patchwork's guides="collect" will merge them into one.
  legend_style <- theme(
    legend.direction      = "horizontal",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.title          = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.key.width      = unit(3.0, "cm"),
    legend.key.height     = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )
  legend_guide <- guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                                               title.hjust = 0.5))

  for (seas in names(season_panels)) {
    season_panels[[seas]] <- season_panels[[seas]] + legend_style + legend_guide
  }

  # Use guide_area() to place the collected legend in its own bottom row
  fig_seas <- (season_panels[["DJF"]] + season_panels[["MAM"]] +
                season_panels[["JJA"]] + season_panels[["SON"]] +
                guide_area()) +
    plot_layout(design = "AB\nCD\nEE", guides = "collect",
                heights = c(1, 1, 0.12)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = parse(text = paste0(
        'bold("Seasonal Spatial Trends: Zhang Slope of "~',
        VAR_LABELS_SHORT[[vname]],
        '~"(1958\u20132025)")'
      ))[[1]],
      subtitle = glue(
        "PWMK | Blue contours: unadjusted p < {ALPHA_LOCAL} ",
        "| Parenthetical % = rejection fraction ",
        "| Shared colour scale"
      ),
      theme = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = TITLE_SIZE, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = SUBTITLE_SIZE, colour = "grey40",
                                     hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10))
      )
    )

  ggsave(file.path(FIG_PHASE3, cfg$fig_seasonal),
         fig_seas, width = 14, height = 15, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  progress_msg(sprintf("    Saved: %s", cfg$fig_seasonal))

  rm(season_panels, fig_seas)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

```

# 6. Review what changed before updating the thesis

The output tables are the source of numerical values. Use full-precision CSVs
for calculations and round only for display. In particular, check:

1. `Input_Audit.csv`: each file has the same 817 month keys and spatial grid.
2. `Annual_Trends_FullPrecision.csv` and `Seasonal_Trends_FullPrecision.csv`:
   updated intervals and block lengths. For identical monthly inputs and package
   behavior, the Zhang slopes/p-values should agree with the previous run;
   use the previous-versus-corrected CSVs to check this.
3. `CI_and_PWMK_Comparison.csv`: any CI/PWMK disagreement remains visible.
4. `Spatial_Local_and_BH_Summary.csv`: actual per-family discovery counts and
   correct minimum-p exponents; zero counts must be reported with their scope.
5. `Legacy_Spatial_Cache_Check.csv`: sample agreement if an old cache was adopted.
6. The regenerated PNGs: check labels and colour scales in the final thesis PDF.

Keep the thesis description aligned with this version: bootstrap the Zhang
estimator; select blocks on residuals; describe the 24-lag positive-clipped
monthly n_eff diagnostic accurately; disclose daily subsampling of the
reference threshold; distinguish nominal local contours from BH discoveries.
No causal attribution or new regional study is added by this framework.

This downstream correction does not assess filter-overlap accuracy on the raw
six-hourly winds or remove below-ground 850-hPa grid cells. Those remain
separate methodological limitations/checks, not silently resolved changes.

## Implementation references

- [zyp documentation](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/zyp/refman/zyp.html):
  Zhang pre-whitening, returned trend and significance, and explicit options.
- [boot::tsboot documentation](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/boot/html/tsboot.html):
  fixed-length block resampling and end correction.
- [blocklength documentation](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/blocklength/refman/blocklength.html):
  PWSD block-length selection.
- [R p.adjust documentation](https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/library/stats/html/p.adjust.html):
  BH adjustment and treatment of the family size.
- [Wilks (2006)](https://doi.org/10.1175/JAM2404.1) and
  [Wilks (2016)](https://doi.org/10.1175/BAMS-D-15-00267.1): field significance,
  correlated local tests and FDR interpretation.
